description: This is a Python source file implementing a storytelling bot that uses pattern-based voice switching and integrates multiple services like TTS, STT, and LLM for an interactive voice storytelling application. It demonstrates pattern matching, voice management, and pipeline construction for real-time speech processing.

classes.name: PatternPairAggregator
classes.description: A class for detecting, managing, and handling pattern pairs within streaming text, used here for voice switching.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context of the LLM conversation, holding messages and system prompts.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates LLM context and user interactions, managing turn strategies and stopping conditions.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a sequence of processing steps for streaming audio and text data.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance along with its parameters for execution.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class representing communication transport mechanisms.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for Daily transport integration.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a data processing pipeline.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame of LLM response execution within the processing pipeline.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Defines stopping strategies for user turns based on turn analysis.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up the pattern matching, voice switching, and runs the overall speech processing pipeline.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the transport and starts the bot.
